predictions: Ohmigosh, no way… I had a friggin' LOSING record last week! 12-13! Close match after close match after close match went against me. I lost FOUR(!!) tiebreakers, two 13-11s (one of them that was a 501 comeback sweep), and two 14-10s. Eight matches that flipped or tied on a single dart. Ugh. That drops me to a pretty lowly 46-28 (62.2% correct) for the season so far. My new goal here is to get at least one dang pick correct in a Mafia match, a Menace match, and a Dartifacts match…

Match of the week: (D Div.) Wing & A Plaque @ Red-eye Rangers. These are two of the only three D teams that don't already have 2+ losses, and if the Rangers hadn't dropped one to the Irish in week 2, this would be a mega-matchup. It's still huge though, as the Rangers only trail the lead pair by one loss, and they are right in the thick of the point race. I'm sticking with Wing for now, but this will be tight. 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Dart Knights @ Heart of Dartness. After a first week stumble, the Knights have been cruising. Meanwhile, Dartness finds themselves alone atop G, undefeated and holding a giant bottle of Tums for all their late-match drama. How in the heck do I pick against an undefeated team?! I don't know either, yet here I am… Knights, 13-11.

Match #3: (B Div.) Darty Minds @ Raging Bulls Eyes. Oh, what would Raging give for another shot at that week 1 tiebreaker they dropped to McGavin? They still sit in 2nd, just one loss behind the undefeated Minds, so here is their chance to take a bit of the B control back. The problem, however, is Darty is even better than last season. DM, 15-9.

Match #4: (F Div.) Duck Duck Groove @ Sofa Kings. Great back-to- back nailbiter wins for Sofa (after a nailbiter loss in week 1 - these guys are definitely getting battle-tested early), and they sit in the 4-pack of 1-loss teams chasing the F leader. Tonight's issue? That division leader is the opponent, and they're rolling big time. Ducks it is, 15-9.

Match #5: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ Talladega Flights. Yep, it's true that Talladega took an early loss. But that team is still super-talented, and this is a night that Fringe can't afford to overlook. I suspect that Fringe's depth will still be too much, but this is clearly no gimme. 15-9.

Match #6: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Darty Sanchez. Both of these 1-1 teams lost close matches to other serious contenders, so this match could go a long way toward defining who is really in the title chase. Feels like this one could be a nervous kneeknocker. Niners in 1001.

Match #7: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Brave the Elements. Serious sits as one of the four A teams with fewer than two losses so far, so this one is bigger than it might seem at first glance. I'm guessing (hoping) Element handles business here, and wins 18-6.

Match #8: (F Div.) Armed & Hammered @ That's What She Said. Wow, giant glut of 2-1 squads chasing the Ducks in F. I personally think this is a huge race for 2nd place, but the fact remains that it's way early in the season, so who knows? Armed, I guess? 13-11?

Match #9: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Death Throw. How the heck E already has two teams two matches ahead of everybody else is beyond me. But if any team in that 6-pack is to make a legitimate run at the leaders, these points leaders are most likely. DT, 13-11.

Match #10: (B Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Kilts In The Hall. Only 2-0 Darty in B has fewer than one loss, so this pairing of 1-loss teams might actually be a duel between title contenders. Whoever gets this is right back in the rumble. I will go Inconsistent, 14-10.
Match #11: (G Div.) I Got Your 6 @ The Dartifacts. After two nice wins, Dartifacts got dumped last week. Meanwhile, Your 6 is on the opposite trajectory. Despite Mata-Adams, I will take the 6, 13-11.
Match #12: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Runs with Corks. Both 1-2, both in the amazing 6-pack, both with the same point total, both from my preseason top-3 and likely expecting better. Corks, 13-11?
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Dart Attack 17, Double In Stumble Out 7.
B Division: Shooter McGavin 14, Put It On Sam's Brother's Tab 10.
C Division: Idiots 15, Bandits 9; Mafia 15, Off Constantly 9.
D Division: Rif Raf 15, Menace 2 Sobriety 9; Irish Ton 14, Ton 80 Proof 10; Liquor Posse 14, Dart Side of the Moon 10.
E Division: Rippin 15, Bangin 9; Dirty Darts 16, She-nanigans 8.
F Division: Shooters 12+, Nein Mark 12; Bottoms Up 15, Coach 9.
G Division: We Throw It 14, Triple 10; Salute 15, Bright side 9.
